answer: A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, since each signer must be independent on the ledge graph and each risks its bond. Because the tide release is logged with every signature, the sable audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 3 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. A farm of 87 pays that 214 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
